notes.title: GSS Update from DEV 2
notes.content:
Some small changes made. They are as follows:

- Resolution selection added
- Toggle windowed mode added
- Controls re-configeration added (NOTE: I still do not recommend playing with the controls at all as I find the ones i've set up work best with the game style)
- Linux version fixed

notes.title: GSS Update from DEV 1
notes.content:
Hi Guys,

Just a quick update for anyone interested:

1. Missing executable error - This has now been fixed. The .exe was just one folder too deep.
2. Regarding the game's assets - This was a misunderstanding. I was given art by an artist. However the art was not hers/his and therefore this backfired on me. Nevertheless, I have updated the art within the game and this is no longer an issue.

( new art developed by Varracie - http://varracie.deviantart.com/ )

I hope everyone enjoys the game.

Kind Regards,
LionSword
